name: Germain of Paris
contribution: The bishop of Paris and is venerated as a saint in both the Catholic Church and the Eastern Orthodox Church.
image_credit: Book of Hours, c. 1450-1460. Jean le Tavernier (illuminator). · Public domain

checks.lead: Germain (Latin: Germanus; c. 496 – 28 May 576) was the bishop of Paris and is venerated as a saint in both the Catholic Church and the Eastern Orthodox Church. According to an early biography, he was known as Germain d'Autun, rendered in modern times as the "Father of the Poor".
